Founded by Dr. Michael and Danielle Pedro, our journey began with a vision to redefine medical aesthetics by blending innovation, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to patient care. Our Story MD Esthetics began as a vision shared by Dr. Michael Pedro and Danielle Pedro, a husband-and-wife team who combined their unique expertise to redefine aesthetic medicine. With Michael’s background in anesthesiology and facial harmony techniques and Danielle’s expertise in business operations and customer experience, they saw an opportunity to create something different—an aesthetics practice rooted in both science and artistry. Their journey started with a single treatment room, a handful of loyal clients, and an unwavering commitment to delivering natural, confidence-boosting results. Instead of chasing trends, they focused on education, precision, and long-term patient care, helping clients enhance their features in a way that felt authentic. Through word-of-mouth referrals and a growing reputation for excellence, MD Esthetics quickly expanded into multiple locations, setting a new standard for aesthetic medicine that prioritizes results, trust, and an elevated patient experience. Today, MD Esthetics is more than just a medspa—it’s a destination for those who want to look and feel their best at every stage of life. Michael and Danielle have cultivated a team of experts who share their passion for innovation and personalized care, ensuring that every patient receives treatments tailored to their unique goals. At MD Esthetics, it’s not about changing how you look—it’s about revealing the best version of yourself. ​ A Commitment to Excellence From day one, MD Esthetics has been dedicated to evidence-based treatments that deliver real, measurable results. Our approach combines: State-of-the-art technology – We invest in the latest advancements in non-invasive and minimally invasive aesthetic medicine. Customized treatment plans – Every patient is unique, and so are our solutions. We tailor every procedure to individual needs. A results-driven philosophy – Science and artistry meet to create natural, transformative results. Education & empowerment – We believe in educating our patients so they can make informed decisions about their treatments. Book an Appointment! About The Founders We go above and beyond to make our patients feel confident! Michael Pedro, MD Board-certified anesthesiologist Michael Pedro, MD, and his wife Danielle founded MD Esthetics in 2018 to help patients age gracefully. Dr. Pedro believes the keys to achieving individualized natural looking beauty are to educate patients on how the aging process is affecting them through a comprehensive consultation, developing a long-term treatment plan, maintaining the high standards of quality, and utilizing evidence-based research and years of clinical expertise. Dr. Pedro is a well-known and respected innovator who uses a holistic approach to combat aging and improve clinical outcomes. Dr. Pedro and the clinical team at MD Esthetics understand the comple xity of factors that influence patients’ looks, such as genetics, environment, lifestyle, and psychology. He also understands that patients may be fearful of “looking fake” and therefore apprehensive in receiving treatment. To help overcome these fears, he uses the “Golden Ratio” to ensure your proportions are harmonized and then creates a tailored cosmetic treatment plan to meet your individual needs. Dr. Pedro received his undergraduate degree from Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, and attended medical school at Saba University School of Medicine. He completed his residency in Anesthesiology at Downstate Medical Center in Brooklyn, New York and is certified by the American Board of Anesthesiology. He has published numerous studies in prestigious medical journals and presents at medical conferences worldwide. Danielle Pedro The “D” in MD Esthetics! Danielle is the Co-Founder and COO of the MD Esthetics brand and is responsible for creating and implementing front and back-office processes for all corporate locations and the MD Esthetics Franchise. She has a bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering with a focus on process improvement and Lean Six Sigma. After working in the supply chain field, she had an opportunity to shadow a salesperson and fell in love with the customer interaction, sales strategy, and independence that came along with that role. Danielle transitioned to sales soon thereafter and spent 8 years in the field before staying at home with her children. Once Danielle was ready to get back to work, she wanted to become an esthetician given her passion for skincare and experience battling acne as a teen. After discussing the idea with Mike, they instead decided to combine their passions and open a medical aesthetics practice. The rest is history. Practice Partnership Opportunities We are a private equity–supported organization committed to partnering with high-quality practices and supporting their continued growth. If you are a practice owner considering a transition or exploring strategic partnership opportunities, we welcome the opportunity to connect.
